facts.fact: The Acta Informatica Pragensia study, of 45 health workers at ten Harare and Bulawayo facilities, evaluates use of the Impilo EHR at the primary healthcare level, in place since 2016.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Child Care

ZWE.note: Abstract says Impilo gathers strategic information but lacks data aggregation servers; no national reporting system status stated.
Document states nothing on school internet or curriculum.
